references.purpose: Interpret curated association records, harmonize variants and traits, track cohort dependencies, and bound ancestry and causal claims.
read_when: resolving traits or querying GWAS Catalog
harmonizing variants, alleles, builds, or effect estimates
interpreting association, locus, or replication claims
references.evidence_boundary: Supports interpretation of retrieved curated association records only; does not establish exhaustive absence, causality, replication independence, gene mechanism, or clinical actionability.
